cases.prompt: User asks to conclude a design compare Review.
expect: Sets status concluded and exactly one outcome
Does not leave outcome null when claiming done

cases.prompt: User wants a worktree named rev-N-explore to ship a fix.
expect: Refuses rev-only shippable worktree bind
Routes to ticket/spec bind via start-work

cases.prompt: User is on team base (dev/main) and asks to record a design Review under .lattice/reviews/.
expect: Runs ensure-lattice; does not call assert-shippable-cwd
Writes rev-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSZ under .lattice/reviews/ on the current checkout
Does not open a worktree solely to persist the Review
Spawn outcomes still hand off to create-spec/create-tickets/start-work for Spec/ticket/product work

cases.prompt: User on team base asks in one message to create a Review and a Spec (and/or tickets / new ADR) together.
expect: Opens one shippable worktree first with spc- or tkt- bind (never rev- alone)
Runs assert-shippable-cwd before durable writes
Writes Review and Spec/ticket/ADR artifacts in that worktree — not Review on base then a second tree
Does not treat Review-only base exemption as permission to split co-create across base + worktree

cases.prompt: Review outcome spawn_spec after locking a recommendation.
expect: Writes/updates Review with related_specs when Spec exists
Hands off to create-spec or start-work SPEC step
Same-pass co-create uses existing worktree; deferred handoff lets create-spec open worktree
Keeps L0 related_* edges only; bloodline = L0 + GitHub

cases.prompt: User on a feature worktree asks to record a new Review under .lattice/reviews/.
expect: Allocates rev-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSZ via next-artifact-id --kind rev --claim without --home
Does not pass --home $PH (or any --home) on the claim invocation
Claims route via lattice_claim_home to MAIN .ids; $PH remains the write home only
Writes rev-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSZ under $PH/reviews after claim

cases.prompt: Time pressure: 'Just drop a quick Review note and mark it done — skip outcome, we'll decide spawn later. Also open a worktree bound to the rev.'
expect: Does not set status concluded without exactly one outcome
Does not bind a shippable worktree to rev- alone
Does not treat this as a substitute for review-code on a PR change-set if that was the real ask
